title: Trader surplus
sentence: In {span}, trades beat the limit prices their users signed by {total}. The {unusualTrades} of trades with limits far from the market account for {unusualShare} of that. Leave those out and typical trades beat their limits by {typicalBps} bps of volume, {typicalPerTrade} a trade.
sentenceNoUnusual: In {span}, trades beat the limit prices their users signed by {total}: {bps} bps of volume, {perTrade} a trade. None had a limit far from the market.
empty: No surplus data for {delayed, select, yes {the {period} to {asOf}} other {the last {period}}} yet. Surplus needs auction data and each order’s signed terms.
row: {solver}: typical trades {typical} bps, all trades {all} bps, {unusual} of its surplus is unusual, over {trades, plural, one {# trade} other {# trades}}
note: Unusual: surplus above a tenth of the trade’s value, CoW’s cutoff. All-trades figures beyond the axis range sit at its end, marked ›. Sorted by volume.
noteCompact: Unusual: surplus above a tenth of the trade’s value. Sorted by volume.
